name: Alto Vista Chapel
scope: The standing Alto Vista Chapel on the coastal rise in Noord, Aruba, with the yellow nave, tiled roof, small pointed steeple and stone entry platform.
era: The standing twentieth-century chapel as photographed in October 2025.

originalReview.notes: Photographer’s contemporaneously self-dedicated October 2025 native image of the standing yellow chapel. Shows the complete front and left nave side, gray-white fascia, warm pointed steeple and three side windows.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Began with the complete published Qualla story inventory. Its chapel views have attribution-bearing licenses. Used the visually inspected exact native CC0 photograph of the chapel by Marc Steenen, bound to the author’s first own-work file and release. No image was used as a surface texture.
